verdict.rationale: Algolia documents an official MCP server that gives agents search, analytics, and recommendations (algolia-mcp skill, an 'MCP Server' docs entry, and a probe confirming it). Its official agent-skills repo also covers index configuration, and a CLI skill handles indices, settings, rules, and synonyms. Agent Studio additionally connects LLMs to Algolia search and tools. Missing for 10: in-depth MCP server documentation listing exposed tools, explicit confirmation that index write operations run through the MCP server itself rather than the CLI skill, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
